ruling.recommended_action: Uphold the $6.61 cancellation fee; no refund. Optionally note to the rider that Ryde has no "driver late vs ETA" free-cancellation rule (unlike other operators), and point them to RydeHELP within 30 days if they wish a discretionary review.
ruling.reasoning:
This is a rider-side cancellation, so the case enters the NS rules through NS-0: cancelled_by = rider on an immediate (non-advanced) job routes to NS-4 [F2][NS-0]. The trace settles the two NS-4 elements: the rider cancelled 3 min 20 s (200 s) after matching, i.e. more than 3 minutes [F2], so the $6.61 cancellation fee stands and the outcome is no_action [F5][NS-4].

The rider's ground is that the driver "was still far away after more than 3 minutes". That is true on the record — the driver's closest approach to the pickup was 2137 m at 21:32:55 [F1] and the platform never recorded him at the pickup point [F3], with no "I'm Here" tap [F4] — but it is not a ground for a refund under Ryde's published rules. Ryde has no "driver later than ETA → free cancellation" rule (NS-8 is informative only and cannot be cited), and NS-4 states expressly that the driver not having arrived does not make the rider's cancellation free [F1][F3][NS-4]. The rider's remedy is a discretionary human appeal under NS-7, not a refund through this decision [NS-7].

The driver's ability to claim anything against the rider is irrelevant here: the fee on record is a rider-side cancellation fee, and the driver never tapped arrival and was never within range, so no waiting-fee or no-show charge against the rider arises [F3][F4][NS-1][NS-6]. NS-2 likewise does not apply — it concerns a driver cancelling on a no-show claim, and here the rider cancelled [F2][NS-2]. NS-1's conditions (driver pressed "I'm Here", was within 200 m, waited over 3 minutes) all fail on the record, so nothing in either party's brief can move the fee [F1][F3][F4][NS-1].

Safety_concern = none, so no escalation is triggered [F7][F8][F10][SAFE-1].

Evidence: the record sets every element this ruling needs — the cancelling party and the cancelled_at/acceptance timestamps [F2], the GPS position report [F1], the arrival-confirmation fields [F3][F4], the fee amount [F5] and the full chat with timestamps [F9].
